name: Enduring Spellbook

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A spellbook that can't be harmed by fire, water or age.
text: This spellbook, along with anything written on its pages, can't be damaged by fire or immersion in water. In addition, the spellbook doesn't deteriorate with age. (No other effect in the game.)
